audience: customer support teams who handle tickets and messages across channels in Trengo

useCases.title: Find open tickets and who they are from
useCases.text: The AI lists tickets filtered by status, contact, assignee, channel or label, with the latest message, so you see what needs an answer.

useCases.title: Read a ticket and summarize the conversation
useCases.text: The AI lists the messages of a ticket, including inbound, outbound and internal notes, and summarizes what the customer wants.

useCases.title: Report on ticket volume and agent performance
useCases.text: The AI reads support metrics for a period, such as created and closed tickets and response times, and per-agent figures, so you see which agent closed the most.

useCases.title: Look up, create or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name, email or phone, opens one, or creates a contact on a channel and sets the contact groups.

useCases.title: Assign, close or reopen a ticket
useCases.text: The AI assigns a ticket to a user or team, closes it with a ticket result such as Resolved, or reopens a closed ticket.

useCases.title: Create a ticket, add a note or reply to a customer
useCases.text: The AI creates a ticket for a contact, and posts an internal note or a message that is delivered to the customer on the ticket's channel.
